quirks: ALL CAPS for part numbers and deadlines

context: Ongoing: Pushrod clevis bends at 1.6x body weight in the tilt stand
Ongoing: Bus-off events at 1 Mbps when all leg actuators stream. This week: Jonas proposes moving to CAN FD at 5 Mbps data rate; Farah wants to fix topology first.

Ongoing: Crossed-roller preload drops after thermal cycling; bore tolerance and preload ring design. This week: Carlos: two hip units feel notchy after thermal soak; preload ring backed off a quarter turn.
Ongoing: Hip winding hits 120 C after 4 min at 60 Nm continuous on the dyno. This week: Retest with spreader and 40 kHz: 9.5 min to limit, close enough to sign off for EVT.
Ongoing: Ratcheting risk at peak torque from loose wave generator fit. This week: Hub switched to 4140 with a clamp plus keyway; shaft rev B released.
Ongoing: Orders sitting in DFM review because of tolerance callouts. This week: Checklist adopted; DFM holds drop but still hit rush orders.
